title: Dunning
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:15 AM
e The creditworthiness factor in percent

e Manual creditworthiness

e Number of dunning notices, returns, and write-offs

The creditworthiness figure is adjusted if a dunning notice or return is reversed.

Prerequisites

Time-Dependent Weighting

To determine the weighted total, enter a time-dependent creditworthiness weighting in Customizing for Contract Accounts
Receivable and Payable under |}Business Transactions » Dunning 3 and/or |}Returns » Define Time-Dependent
Creditworthiness Weightings

Dunning

If you want to use scoring, enter the dunning activities and/or dunning charges in conjunction with a creditworthiness figure. The
dunning activity run reads the current creditworthiness of a business partner and selects the dunning activity and dunning charge
where the creditworthiness determined is greater or the same as the creditworthiness value defined in Customizing.

You can define a creditworthiness weighting in the dunning levels of dunning procedures. Once dunning has taken place, the
creditworthiness figure of the current month is increased by this number.

You can define the creditworthiness figure in each dunning procedure and dunning level (in Customizing for Contract Accounts

Receivable and Payable under |}Business Transactions » Dunning » Configure Dunning Activities 5 and Configure Charge
Schedules for Dunning Procedure).

Returns

If you want to use scoring, enter the returns activities in conjunction with a creditworthiness figure. During returns processing, the
creditworthiness of a business partner is determined automatically, and, depending on this creditworthiness among other things,

the returns activity where the creditworthiness value determined is greater or the same as the value defined in Customizing is
selected.

You can define a credit weighting in the returns reasons. Once returns processing has taken place, the creditworthiness figure of
the current month is increased by this figure.

You can define the creditworthiness weighting with the returns reason in Customizing (see Customizing for Contract Accounts
Receivable and Payable under |}Business Transactions » Returns » Configure Returns Reasons 3).

Write-Offs

Write-offs can also have a negative effect on a customer's creditworthiness. If you want to use scoring, enter the write-offs in
conjunction with a creditworthiness score.

You can define the creditworthiness weighting with the write-off reasons in Customizing (see Customizing for Contract Accounts
Receivable and Payable under |Business Transactions » Write-Offs » Configure Write-Off Reasons 3).

Installment Plan
